newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes higher in dull session.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes higher in dull session.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed stronger at 43.7500/7600 to the dollar in a dull interbank session on Saturday against a previous close of 43.7600/7700, dealers said.
The local currency was quoted at 43.7500/7800 per dollar at one point but edged up later in weak trade with international markets closed for the weekend.

Call money was traded at eight to 11 percent against the previous five to six percent. Call rates shot up following payment by some banks for the purchase of central bank bills worth more than 1.5 billion taka during an auction on Wednesday.
